method: finite-action contextual Monte Carlo cost/value regression; terminal full-task returns, no Bellman bootstrap claim
state_origin: causal RETURN slot 2, before first posture intervention
feature_policy: estimated q/dq minus current reference; measured force/moment norms; phase elapsed. All inputs captured live before action.
reward: qualification first, then negative complete-task force integral; matched B and native truth are offline labels only
models: ridge with explicit action-specific state slopes
qualification: predict every original margin with same feature map; conservative lower confidence margin and support distance; no future-label runtime mask
selection: H150 default; choose alternative only if all predicted original margins positive with development calibrated residual buffer and force advantage exceeds development prediction error; direct Q argmin diagnostic separately
evaluation: held-out parent selection regret, action ranking, qualification and costs vs fixed H150 and best train-only global action; independent raw audit
promotion: Q_GENERALIZATION_PASS only with qualified physical improvement vs H150 on all test parents, nonconstant selections, and improvement vs globally best fixed action; otherwise not demonstrated
few_repetition: requires actual completed repetition feedback and a subsequent actual re-admitted task. Cold fork dataset is not repetition learning.
p2_status: conditional; separate budget; no starts yet
